payload.title: Verify read.p.apyr.us serves the stream with no redirect after deploy-edge
payload.description:
State as of 2026-10-19 16:40Z. read.p.apyr.us still redirects to /information, which returns 404. The fix ships with the 1.19.1 bump on p.apyr.us (PR 42) and the in-build deploy-edge.

Live checks once the p.apyr.us build finishes: read.p.apyr.us/ serves the stream with no redirect; /information is gone; apyr.us still redirects to p.apyr.us; the edge distributions E17ZRAI87DN065 and E2EM0JLBC2W9WW are adopted.
Next step: run the checks after the deploy; if any fail, read the Amplify build log for app ds6yswxui41yi and the edge adoption output.
Blocker: waits on p.apyr.us PR 42 merging and its build.
Owner thread: Papyrus CMS fix on the Mac (offline) or any session with network access.
